reason: Show captured prior-decision validation without recomputing judgments, and durable retry state for data-blocked hypothesis development.
Graph engines and deferred loading are owned by the current view, including repeated init and detached-container cleanup.
The existing AI review renderer referenced spans and firstAttempt from an unrelated function scope; bind them to this section's execution data.
Private request client, bounded path-sensitive cache, latest-only publication and read-only active request API.
Latest-request lanes prevent obsolete query results and loading finalizers from replacing newer lists.
View/layout generations cancel stale scroll restoration, observer callbacks and browser transitions. Realtime batches no longer suppress rendering during network waits.
Account-qualified timeline caches accept legacy deep links. Stable charts retain zoom; removed charts, queued frames and resize observers are disposed.
Case tabs retain their own scroll positions across rapid switches through shorter content; DOM-scoped history is released with the dialog.
Content-addressed release version is shared by bundle, HTML and service worker.
